raw:
SELECT 
  "CDSCode",
  "School Name",
  "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS "Free Meal Rate (%)"
FROM main."frpm"
WHERE 
  "County Name" = 'Alameda' 
  AND "Academic Year" = '2014-15'
ORDER BY "School Name"
